mainEntity.name: Can GOE help contractors specializing in niche services, like historic home restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, GOE can be particularly effective for contractors specializing in niche services like historic home restoration. By targeting very specific, long-tail keywords that general contractors might not use (e.g., 'Victorian trim repair specialist', 'brownstone restoration NYC'), a GOE strategy can connect you directly with clients actively seeking your unique expertise. This precision targeting often results in higher-quality leads and less competition, making your specialized services more visible to the right audience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, GOE is effective for niche contractors by targeting specific, long-tail keywords that connect them directly with clients seeking their unique expertise, resulting in higher-quality leads.
